title: Parts ON gives access to the Parts configuration pages
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON and the Parts sub-toggle ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open the Settings area and look for the Parts pages.
custom_expected: The Parts pages are available: Bins, Categories and Pricing.
evidence: UI (role settingsParts): the PARTS config group is present — Pricing, Bin Locations, Categories. screenshot settings-SetX.
